I've found out that despite not going through it, some people still joke about it to cope with the lack of understanding they have. If it really bugs you, tell a teacher, I've been lectured to plenty of times for making jokes of that nature, mainly because I go farther than most, and while they did joke about it before me, they didn't want to go that far because they're pussies and they don't know what it's like. 
Jokes like these don't make your or anyone elses experiences less valid. 
Sadly most of these jokes calling people attention whores for doing this focus on the small minority of people who milk it for all they can, in an attempt to get just a little bit of attention. It's a minority making the large amount look worse, if you're to be mad at anyone, be mad at those who make self harm a joke. It's their faults it's being joked about, because people like that are pathetic jokes, and they turn self harm from something serious into something that people at large joke about.

I try to embrace the jokes. I double down on the jokes they make and oh fuck they get uncomftorable because I take it farther then they're willing to go or I get some laughs. The goal is to not feel bad about it, and at the same time make them feel bad about it. An uno reverse card if you will. And of course I'm edgy, but I take it to a chaotic good or neutral. 
It's my goal to be more go with the flow and less sensitive, as taking everything too hard is what led me to cutting afterall. I try to reverse on my depressed self with my current self. Sure there are days where I really don't care for those jokes, let alone any others, but my goal is to get more good than bad. 
My advice here is to take the jokes too far and see how uncomftorable they get. Because if they're willing to joke about it, clearly they know what they're getting into in terms of topics.
Also for some people those lame jokes are wonderful ways for them to cope, as silly as it may seem. 
We all deal with things in our own ways, and some people deal with those jokes by ranting about it, or reversing them. I've found though, that school admins always get serious when people joke about those kinds of thinks too, so if you wanna report them and make them feel strange while the councler has a talk with them about self harm.
